# Descaling your Barista Express

The Barista Express has a **descale** mode. Here is how to run it.

## What you need

* Breville descaling powder or [citric acid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Citric_acid)
* A large container under the group head

## Steps

1. Empty the drip tray and fill the tank with the solution.
2. Press and hold the 1 CUP and 2 CUP buttons together for 5 seconds.
3. Turn the dial to hot water, then to steam, and let the tank run empty.

![machine](https://example.com/img.jpg)
